scan_metadata.run_note: Partial scan. Verified candidate subset from a limited sweep (6 corridors, 24 ZIP-level queries, 2 aggregator geo-searches, direct candidate verification). All 48 grid ZIPs now have at least one executed query row. Each ZIP is a single African-label query, not the full hide-label matrix, so ZIP rows are partial. 4 units are not executed (customs, state health, SBA PPP, registry mirrors) and 3 are blocked (INBiz, ATC, Marion County health). Coverage is 60 of 65 units. Round 3 of datasets: the Marion County food-license portal (6,884 grid records, 955 grocery-licensed) and the SBA PPP FOIA (17,734 Indiana grid rows, 146 food-retail borrowers) are executed. Customs (HTTP 403 from both sites) and ISDH (ASP.NET form, no ZIP endpoint) are blocked. Registry mirrors were not run as a geography sweep. Dataset rows (INBiz, SNAP, customs, ATC, DBNS, county health) were not run as geography sweeps. Do not treat this file as a full market census.

qualifying_businesses_note: Contract deviation: full duplicate records not written. Qualifying = the non-hold entries. Hold entries are the operator verification queue and do not qualify until verified.
category_definition: An independent walk-in retail storefront selling African pantry staples (fufu/poundo flour, gari, egusi, ogbono, teff, injera, berbere, red palm oil, stockfish), fresh or frozen tropical produce and proteins, and African health-and-beauty goods. Product-first retail defines the category; an attached kitchen or butchery counter does not. Platform labels are not qualification evidence.
geographic_classification_notes: All verified candidates are inside Marion County (Indianapolis, including Pike and Wayne Township addresses). Adjacent municipalities were not swept.
ownership_exclusion_notes: No national chains, national franchises or regional chains observed in verified candidates. Ownership for Saraga and TETEES is unknown.

sweep_ledger.unit: SBA PPP loan records (data.sba.gov PPP FOIA, 13 CSV files, 240930 release)

Absence means the extract did not reach them, not a negative finding. Macca Market LLC (1205 S High School Rd) added as a PPP-only lead.
